registeredBy: sisyphus-junior (agent) — PRE-REGISTERED before the run; do not tune after start

budgets.rss_over_baseline_note: aggregate Orca-owned RSS must stay below the start-of-full-load baseline + 1 GiB
budgets.final4h_growth_note: growth over the final four active hours below 100 MiB/hour
budgets.idle_cpu_note: idle-period aggregate CPU averages below 20% of one core over 15-minute windows
budgets.cpu_sustained_note: never sustain above one core for five minutes absent a known job

schedule.warmup: a few projects (synthetic, labeled) to validate the harness

baseline.machine: 32 cores, 31 GiB RAM; load ~23 at baseline (loaded, not idle)
baseline.note: Stage B budgets are measured against the loaded baseline, not an idle machine

operator_cap_note: Design §8: if the baseline already exceeds acceptable machine headroom, the OPERATOR sets a stricter cap before testing. No stricter cap was set at registration time, so the design defaults apply.

measurement.process_set: Orca-owned processes sampled by orca-workspace-watchdog.service (electron main/renderers/gpu/utility/zygote, orcad/relay, orca helpers); agent PTYs excluded and reported separately
